input.name: Fictional lab Norwind releases open model Arda 2

echoes.title: Norwind releases Arda 2 with open weights
echoes.summary: The fictional lab Norwind published the weights of Arda 2, a 70-billion-parameter model, under a permissive license.

echoes.title: Arda 2 tops two coding benchmarks, Norwind says
echoes.summary: Norwind's own report claims Arda 2 beats its predecessor on two coding benchmarks.
echoes.page: Norwind's technical report lists results on two coding benchmarks and one reasoning benchmark. The lab says a smaller 8-billion-parameter version will follow next month, and that an API for the large model is planned but has no date. Independent evaluations have not been published yet.

echoes.title: Developers try Norwind's Arda 2 on a single GPU
echoes.summary: Early users report the quantised model runs on one consumer GPU, slowly.
